label: AP analyst, every country says urgent

taps.question: How clear are you on what is expected of you this week?
How supported do you feel by your manager this week?
How much do you feel part of the team this week?
How well has your training prepared you for your work this week?
How manageable is your workload this week?

conversation.text: You said what is expected of you this week is unclear. What is happening?

Every country team says their invoices are urgent, but nobody told me which country takes priority. I lose time asking around to figure it out and end up missing my quota by about 20 invoices some days.
What would help you know which country takes priority?
A simple priority order from my lead or having one person who decides would help me know which country to process first.
